title: Understanding Market Sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM)
text: Market sizing is a critical step in validating a startup idea. TAM (Total Addressable Market) represents the total revenue opportunity if you achieved 100% market share. SAM (Serviceable Available Market) is the portion of TAM you can acquire based on your business model, geography, or target demographic. SOM (Serviceable Obtainable Market) is the realistic market share you can capture in the short term, given your resources and competition. Investors look for a large TAM to ensure venture-scale returns, but they also want to see a clear path to capturing a specific SOM initially.
